conclusion_scope: Visible line power_in/power_out pins use the same numbered native terminals. The confirmed record subset has no KiCad electrical type field. Node=0 is not a permanent NC prohibition: FindNodeLine promotes endpoint nodes after geometric connections. Group paste forces pin-attribute graphics onto LAY_PIN_LINE. NC therefore rejects by default; explicit lossy mode preserves the physical number but emits an ordinary connectable terminal. Number identity does not imply ERC, NC enforcement, native import or physical package validation.
